items.headline: Oracle set June 10, 2026 for Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings release and conference call
Oracle announced a bilingual advertising campaign for Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico
Oracle said Ishan Technologies selected Oracle Communications for a digital transformation program
Oracle disclosed Samsung Electronics is adopting Oracle Java SE Universal Subscription
Oracle, BorderPlex, and Bloom Energy said Project Jupiter will use Bloom fuel cells to power the AI data center campus
